decisions.title: 🚨 Add shared DiT runtime and migrate denoiser models
decisions.decision: Shared DiT runtime changes weight, scratch and graph ownership. Needs per-model PCM validation before a port.

decisions.title: Add reusable device denoising and MOSS SoundEffect fusions
decisions.decision: MOSS sound-effect device denoising is a separate model path from the configured YuE2.

decisions.title: Add session-owned PreparedGraph execution and scheduler support
decisions.decision: PreparedGraph requires coordinated backend allocator and graph lifetime changes. Kept the existing Native scheduler.

decisions.title: Run YuE2 on the SYCL backend
decisions.decision: SYCL-oriented YuE2 lowering, cache and denoiser options alter the execution path. The current RX 580 uses the existing Vulkan lowering.

decisions.title: Remove logging-only tensor readbacks and complete session timing
decisions.decision: Logging readback removal applies to other voice sessions. The current YuE2 hot path is profiled separately.

decisions.title: Improve Kokoro CPU convolution matrix layout
decisions.decision: Kokoro CPU convolution layout is separate from YuE2.
